descriptions.description: COMMENT Only the original Algerian reports sub Rhynchostegiella tenella (Dicks.) Limpr. and Rhynchostegium tenellum (Dicks.) Schimp. are included here.

RECORDS. — Bescherelle (1882): Alger; Birkadem; Édough, près la route Randon; Bougie; Oran; Philippeville; Tlemcen. Trabut (1887 a): D’Oran à Mécheria. Julien (1894): Région de Constantine. Ros et al. (1990): Djebel Chenoua, 5 - 40 m. Boukhatem et al. (2017): El-Kala National Park, Tonga lake watershed. Frequent.
